resources.name: Basic Needs Food Pantry
resources.description: Groceries and short-term food support. A good first stop when the week is stretching your budget.
resources.step: Read the current visit instructions, complete the student profile if requested, and have your Cal ID or ID number ready.
prepare: Cal ID or Cal ID number
Current visiting instructions on the pantry page

resources.name: Basic Needs Center
resources.description: A starting point for food, housing, and financial challenges, especially when several needs overlap.
resources.step: Use the Basic Needs Assistance Form or check the Welcome Center and appointment options.
prepare: A brief description of the support you need
Questions you want help navigating

resources.name: CalFresh application support
resources.description: Help understanding the application process and getting connected to a CalFresh ambassador.
resources.step: Review the official application-assistance page and book a support appointment. Eligibility is determined by the program.
prepare: Read the current application guidance
Ask the adviser which documents apply to your situation

resources.name: Financial Aid & Scholarships
resources.description: Find aid information, application guidance, and ways to ask questions about your financial aid.
resources.step: Start with the current student guidance and use the office’s official contact process.
prepare: Your specific aid question
Relevant notices, kept private until you contact the official office

resources.name: Cal Student Central
resources.description: A front door for enrollment, payments, financial aid, and the administrative questions between them.
resources.step: Search the official guidance or open a case through Cal Student Central. Some actions require CalNet and a secure campus network.

resources.name: Berkeley Housing
resources.description: Explore university housing options, application information, and resident resources.
resources.step: Choose your student housing category and check the current application dates and requirements.
prepare: Your student housing category
Your preferred term and housing needs

resources.name: Student Learning Center
resources.description: Peer learning, course support, and a place to build a more sustainable study routine.
resources.step: Choose your subject or learning program, then check its current service format and schedule.

resources.name: Writing support at the SLC
resources.description: Work through a course writing assignment, from a rough idea to a draft you can revise.
resources.step: Check weekly tutoring, drop-in, and appointment options. Weekly tutoring has a request and orientation process.
prepare: Your assignment prompt
Notes, an idea, or a working draft

resources.name: Math & statistics support
resources.description: Find SLC subject support for mathematics and statistics courses.
resources.step: Check the supported courses and current tutoring schedule before visiting.
resources.sourceNote: University Statistics tutoring directory also describes free SLC drop-in support.

resources.name: Library spaces & hours
resources.description: Find a library, check its current hours, and look for a place to work.
resources.step: Use the Library’s current location and hours information; opening times and room access vary.

resources.name: Academic advising & tutoring
resources.description: Find the right academic advising route for your college, major, or course questions.
resources.step: Use Berkeley’s advising directory to identify your college or program’s advising office.
prepare: Your college and major, if applicable
A short list of the decisions you need help with

resources.name: Counseling & Psychological Services
resources.description: Explore short-term counseling and the current ways to connect with a CAPS counselor.
resources.step: Read the official options for making an appointment. Availability and the appropriate service are determined by UHS.
prepare: Questions about the current appointment process
For virtual counseling, check UHS location requirements
resources.sourceNote: UHS states counseling is available at no charge; cancellation fees and other services can differ.

resources.name: Let’s Talk
resources.description: An informal conversation with a counselor when you want a starting point, rather than formal counseling.
resources.step: Check the current Let’s Talk locations and schedule on UHS. This is an informal consultation service, not ongoing therapy.

resources.name: University Health Services
resources.description: Find student healthcare services, appointment information, and service-specific fees.
resources.step: Review the relevant UHS service and its current access and billing information.
resources.cost: Fees depend on service and coverage

resources.name: Recreation & Wellbeing
resources.description: Find a way to move, unwind, and meet people through recreation and campus activities.
resources.step: Check student access, current schedules, and any program-specific registration or fees.
resources.cost: Many services included; some extra fees

resources.name: Disabled Students’ Program
resources.description: Learn about accommodations and the process for accessing disability-related support.
resources.step: Start with the new-student process or current-student guidance. DSP determines individual accommodations.
prepare: Read DSP’s application and documentation guidance
Questions about the barriers you want to discuss

resources.name: PATH to Care Center
resources.description: Find confidential support resources for people affected by sexual violence, harassment, or relationship violence.
resources.step: Use the Center’s official support and contact pages to explore available options.
prepare: You can start by asking what support options are available
Choose what you are comfortable sharing with the official service

resources.name: Student Legal Services
resources.description: Find the university’s student legal consultation information and appointment process.
resources.step: Review the office’s scope and eligibility before requesting a consultation. This guide does not provide legal advice.

resources.name: Student Advocate’s Office
resources.description: Student-led casework for academic, financial-aid, conduct, and grievance concerns.
resources.step: Choose the relevant division and use its current contact instructions.
prepare: A concise summary of your concern
Relevant dates and notices for your own reference

resources.name: Bear Transit
resources.description: Find campus shuttle routes, maps, and the current service schedule.
resources.step: Choose the route that matches your trip and check the current schedule and fare/access rules.

resources.name: Night Safety Shuttle
resources.description: Explore Berkeley’s night shuttle options for getting around after a late study session.
resources.step: Check the current route, timetable, and holiday exceptions. This guide does not show live arrivals.

resources.name: Cal 1 Card
resources.description: Manage your campus ID, replacement-card information, and related access services.
resources.step: Choose the current card action you need on the official Cal 1 Card site.

resources.name: Student Technology Services
resources.description: A starting point for tech support, Wi-Fi guidance, printing, and student technology resources.
resources.step: Choose the relevant support topic and follow its official request instructions.

resources.name: Device lending
resources.description: Explore student device-loan programs when access to a computer is getting in the way.
resources.step: Check current lending programs, availability, and eligibility before making a request.
prepare: What device access you need
Read the current loan duration and return requirements

resources.name: Career Engagement appointments
resources.description: Talk through career questions and find support for your next application or decision.
resources.step: Review current appointment formats and book through the official service.
prepare: The question you want to work on
A draft résumé or role description, if relevant

resources.name: Handshake
resources.description: Find jobs, internships, employer events, and Berkeley career opportunities.
resources.step: Use Berkeley’s official Handshake sign-in instructions; student accounts are created through the university process.

resources.name: Undergraduate research & scholarships
resources.description: Explore URAP, research programs, scholarships, and ways to get involved in research.
resources.step: Choose a program and check its current eligibility, deadlines, and application guidance.

resources.name: Berkeley International Office
resources.description: Find international student advising, campus-transition guidance, and official immigration resources.
resources.step: Choose the student services route for your situation and contact an adviser for individual questions.

resources.name: Educational Opportunity Program
resources.description: Explore academic counseling, community, and support programs through EOP.
resources.step: Read EOP’s student and eligibility guidance, then choose the service or appointment route that fits.

resources.name: Transfer Student Center
resources.description: A place to navigate the transition to Berkeley and connect with other transfer students.
resources.step: Explore current transfer support, community programs, and advising options.

resources.name: Student Parent Center
resources.description: Find student-parent resources, community, and guidance across family and academic life.
resources.step: Start with the Student Parent Navigator or contact the Center about your needs.

resources.name: Graduate Division resources
resources.description: Find graduate-student guidance, support, writing, professional development, and community resources.
resources.step: Choose the current student resource area that matches your question.
